case.pattern: card-not-present fraud from a new device

evidence.claim: Card C03042-K1 was evaluated for transaction 3464869 ($599.94, online channel, risk score 0.77) on 2016-11-17. Local similar case history reveals prior confirmed fraud cases on this same card/customer (CC-0615 and CC-3886) involving unauthorized online transactions from unrecognized new devices, as well as one cleared alert (CC-1313).

case.summary: Card C03042-K1 was evaluated for transaction 3464869 ($599.94, online channel, risk score 0.77) on 2016-11-17. Local similar case history reveals prior confirmed fraud cases on this same card/customer (CC-0615 and CC-3886) involving unauthorized online transactions from unrecognized new devices, as well as one cleared alert (CC-1313).

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card.

initial.reason: Fraud probability is 0.85 with historical online fraud on the same card, but exposure is below $2,500 and the least disruptive step-up auth is appropriate initially.

final.reason: Customer confirmed they did not make the purchase and still possess the card, verifying unauthorized card-not-present fraud. With fraud probability at 0.85 and exposure below $2,500, BLOCK_CARD on route L1 is required.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer validation confirmed unauthorized purchases, escalating the response from step-up authentication to blocking the compromised card.

sar.reason: No structured SAR decision was requested.
